method: Read only the assigned input and two rubrics. Inspected the four reference PNGs first, individually, then all forty full candidate PNGs using view_image in the supplied candidate and within-candidate order, viewing each screen's two sizes sequentially. Judged each paired screen conservatively against the references' painted ornament, lavender lettering, worn brass, light and spatial framing. Holistic scores are not arithmetic means; 9 requires the same painted hand. Large type and scrolling were treated as intentional. Standalone preview banners and unchanged combat room, actor and hand art were excluded; combat background scores concern the remaining framing and integration only. No browser, rendering, source, metadata, other reports or interaction testing were used. The combat treatments were visually equivalent within the excluded differences, so their ranking is a stable tie-break in supplied order.

winner_fixes: Gameover, right deck column: replace the uniform glossy row faces with worn purple enamel or velvet carrying localized candle highlights; retain the single-column titles and distinct right-hand counts.

Rest, upper-right requirement plaques: give each textured purple plaque a shaped brass cartouche perimeter and modeled corner transitions instead of a hard rectangular silhouette, keeping its current readable text size.

Rest, event, gameover and shop, primary lavender headings: paint irregular pale edge highlights, violet interior modulation and restrained cast shadows into the letter faces to match the references' carved lettering rather than relying on even fill and shadow.

Event, lower parchment-to-rail boundary: show the sheet receding behind the brass lip with a narrow uneven shadow and visible paper continuation at the side recesses, keeping the reading window and scroll cue.

Gameover, full-width Memorial Record rail: retain the carved material but replace the stretched central ornament with proportionate motifs and physically joined corner blocks aligned with the fine vertical frames.
Shop, lower Shop Shelves rail: preserve the current merchant, cards, curtains and price staging while giving the rail a correctly scaled central carving and a shaped inset nameplate.
Gameover, left How Far region: align the progress numeral, Wings Explored label and location into a coherent inset composition with restrained painted detailing around the existing large text.

Combat-floaters, both upper condition groups: sharpen the cyan and coral letter interiors, reduce the blurred glow, and give their brass supports a quieter patina while retaining readable local owner headings.
Rest and event, lower reading-lip nameplates: replace the plain rectangular label patches with shallow engraved plaques that join the carved support without a hard black seam.

grafts.idea: Carry the textured purple inset treatment of the progress panel and deck rows into the winner's glossy deck list while retaining its separate title and count columns.
Use the relaxed line spacing and distinct name, companion and Haunt Level lines in the portrait captions as the spacing model for the winner's memorial captions.
Borrow the shaped gold cartouche silhouette of the requirement badges, combining it with the winner's textured purple materials instead of the square plaques.
